title: Say It in Your Own Words: Paraphrasing and Summarizing
objective: Students transform source sentences into clear original English.
context: Classroom source: Field Note A, by Mali. “Students saw twelve butterflies in the sunny garden. They saw five in the shaded garden. They watched each garden for ten minutes.”

items.prompt: Retell the two counts in your own words. Name the source.
items.answer: Mali reports five butterflies in shade and twelve in sun. Accept accurate paraphrases.
items.hint: Change the order of the places.

items.prompt: Write a one-sentence summary of the main finding.
items.answer: More butterflies were seen in the sunny garden during the observation.
items.hint: A summary may omit some details.

items.prompt: Name one detail your summary kept and one it left out. Explain your choice.
items.answer: Accept two accurate details from the student’s own summary and a reason for keeping the main idea.
items.hint: Check your summary against the original text.
